COST: 402

Notes on the plan:
- Car1 does all the work; car2 stays at Tadi hospital because bringing it to Panchakanya would cost 42 minutes without saving any driving.
- Dhunche temple is not an evacuation point, so all drop-offs are at Panchakanya shelter.
- Driving totals 362 minutes. The two adults left at Syaphru farm are deferred (40 penalty), because a further trip there would cost 68 minutes of driving to save only 40.
- Trishuli care home is reachable only via Myagang farm, since the Gajuri bridges are down.
- Thakre market is reached through Dhunche temple, because the Panchakanya road is blocked.
- Working-age adults and the bus drivers count as adults. The schoolchildren and the schoolgirl count as children.
